entries.subject: DAMIT 939: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-939.txt. Model 939, version 2016-01-04, pole (234°, 32°), period 25.2287 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Original shape table
entries.finding: [Original shape table](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/3537/shape.txt) — counted XYZ vertices and one-based triangle indices.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive models: Model 940: pole (28°, 34°), period 25.2285 h. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 940: pole (28°, 34°), 25.2285 h, version 2016-01-04. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "92.915 km (size-calibrated model)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 185.83 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 118, DAMIT model 939 diameter 169 ± 1 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 939 fitted to 2 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
